name: Sega 32X
significance: A cautionary tale of hardware fragmentation, launching mere months before the Sega Saturn and dividing developer resources.

verifiedFactualData.ram: 256 KB main RAM, 256 KB framebuffer VRAM

editorialContent.overview: Sega's intermediate 32-bit mushroom-shaped add-on attempting to bridge the Genesis with the impending 32-bit era.
editorialContent.marketLegacy: A cautionary tale of hardware fragmentation, launching mere months before the Sega Saturn and dividing developer resources.
